name: dashboard
description: Dashboard tile: one title, one key number (the largest text) or trend with a reference, uniform tiles, red/green only on a signed change, no decoration.

semantic_coverage.question: Does the figure cover the concepts that matter in the source?

anchors.1-2: wrong topic or generic; almost no source-specific content
anchors.3-4: domain recognisable, most key components missing
anchors.5-6: main idea present, important mechanisms omitted or distorted
anchors.7-8: most concepts and relationships present, minor omissions
anchors.9-10: complete, source-specific coverage of stages and relationships

semantic_coverage.judge: Does the figure show the components and stages the source names, and the relationships between them?

hallucination_control.question: Are all visible elements justified by the source?

anchors.3-4: major unsupported components alter the method
anchors.5-6: core idea recognisable, several invented details
anchors.7-8: minor embellishments or one wrong label

hallucination_control.judge: Is every visible element justified by the source? Flag invented modules, labels, branches or decoration.

topology_accuracy.question: Does grouping, hierarchy and containment reflect the intended structure?

anchors.7-8: mostly correct, minor grouping or proportion issues

topology_accuracy.judge: Do grouping, hierarchy and containment match the structure of the method?

flow_readability.question: Can a reader follow the flow: arrow direction, endpoints, crossings, reading order?

anchors.1-2: flow unreadable; arrows missing, chaotic or misleading
anchors.3-4: major confusion from wrong arrows, crossings, overlaps, order
anchors.5-6: flow inferable but routing or spacing slows reading
anchors.7-8: clear flow with minor arrow or spacing imperfections
anchors.9-10: very clear, economical flow, no ambiguity

flow_readability.judge: Can a cold reader follow the flow: arrow direction, endpoints, crossings, reading order, spacing?

text_quality.question: Label correctness, font consistency, legibility, placement, overflow.

anchors.1-2: illegible, garbled or mostly missing text
anchors.3-4: severe text errors or glyph deformation
anchors.5-6: readable with noticeable spelling, placement or blur defects
anchors.7-8: mostly correct and clean, minor local defects
anchors.9-10: accurate, sharp, well placed, typographically consistent

text_quality.judge: Are labels correct, legible at the intended size, well placed, consistent in font, not overflowing?

visual_polish.question: Restrained palette, consistent strokes, balanced whitespace, contrast, no artifacts.

anchors.3-4: messy composition, harsh or inconsistent styling
anchors.5-6: acceptable but visibly rough or unbalanced

visual_polish.judge: Is the palette restrained, strokes consistent, whitespace balanced, contrast adequate, no artifacts?

medium_fit.question: Does the figure follow the conventions of its medium (paper, slide, dashboard, icon)?

anchors.3-4: amateurish or wrong register for the medium
anchors.9-10: fully aligned with the medium's conventions

medium_fit.judge: Does the figure follow the conventions of its medium (paper, teaching, slide, chart, tile, icon)?

compactness.question: Economical use of the canvas: margins, spacing, connector length, density balance.

anchors.1-2: content occupies a small fraction of the canvas
anchors.3-4: large blank margins or gaps; stretched connectors
anchors.5-6: usable but uneven density or oversized spacing
anchors.7-8: compact, mostly even, minor wasted space
anchors.9-10: economical, evenly distributed, no wasted area

compactness.judge: Is the canvas used economically: margins, spacing, connector length, density balance?

checks.description: a blank band wider than the medium's margin on any side
content outside the canvas
canvas aspect outside the medium's range (banner or tower)
a connector far longer than its displacement
arrow crossings
diagonal routing without a semantic flag
an arrow passing through a block
a marker-ended arrow with a shaft under 20px
most arrows run against reading order
font below the medium's minimum
a label longer than the medium allows
text/background contrast below the threshold
text over a gradient or pattern fill
a label wider than its block
checks.signal: estimated text width vs host block

checks.description: two labels overlapping
more font families than allowed
more accent colours than allowed
a neon fill or stroke
a gradient or pattern fill
a filter effect
oversized corner radius
more stroke widths than allowed
black background
planned components not labelled
a label with no basis in the source
an empty container
nothing drawn
no canvas size
two arrows sharing a collinear shaft (two heads, ambiguous endpoints)
an arrow striking through a label
a label that is a sentence (trailing full stop or sentence opener)
elements that draw nothing but stretch the content box
checks.signal: opacity 0, display none, no fill and no stroke, background-coloured

checks.description: the key number is not the largest text in its tile
checks.signal: font sizes of numeric vs other texts per tile

checks.description: red/green without a signed delta, threshold or status word
checks.signal: hue class of value text / stripe / border vs tile text

checks.description: a sparkline without baseline, end values or span caption
checks.signal: line / end labels / caption inside the tile

checks.description: tiles in one row with different widths, gutters or styles
a token travelling from arrowhead to tail
checks.signal: offset-distance keyframes, animation-direction, path vs reversed flow

checks.description: a target revealed before its source
a control token faster or as dark as data tokens
checks.signal: travel duration and fill luminance per token

checks.description: no (or an incomplete) prefers-reduced-motion block
motion that encodes nothing
checks.signal: paths that are no flow, infinite/alternate on non-tokens, animated properties beyond opacity/dashoffset

textual_overload.description: full sentences or more than 15 words in a box; literal copying of the source

chaotic_routing.description: crossings and detours that defeat reading order

illegible_type.description: fonts below the medium's minimum or low contrast

hallucination.description: elements with no basis in the source

embedded_title_or_watermark.description: figure title or watermark inside the drawing (paper figures)

misleading_data.description: a chart that misstates the data: truncated bar axis, bars not to scale, dual axis, legend that names the wrong series

motion_misleads.description: animation that runs against the flow or is lost to reduced-motion users

scoring: 10 per dimension; a critical defect caps the dimension at 5; each further defect subtracts its penalty; floor 1; dimensions without evidence are not assessed; overall = weighted mean of assessed dimensions
